name: Itinerari 7 - El Camí de Llevant: de Montserrat a Salses
description_md:
Itinerari 7 - El Camí de Llevant: de Montserrat a Salses is a waymarked hiking route located in Spain. This hard trail spans a distance of 687.9 km with 15664 m of ascent and 15830 m of descent.

The route requires about 214 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and is part of a national waymarked hiking network. It is signposted as CC-C and the line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. Walkers will find that the path passes Montserrat, Sant Josep Convent, and Cross of St. Pere Galligants within 100 m.
